brand.name: Learning with Toma
brand.tagline: Printable worksheets for little learners, ready in seconds.
brand.mission: Help parents, speech-language professionals, and educators create engaging, personalized learning activities for every child.
brand.vision: Make quality learning materials accessible, beautiful, and effortless to create.
brand.positioning: A free, friendly website that makes personalized printable learning worksheets for children aged 4–7 in seconds, in English, Croatian and Serbian.
values: Parents should feel supported, not overwhelmed.

bodyCopy.name: Body copy
bodyCopy.use: long text in About and Want to help?

accent.name: Accent orange
accent.use: main buttons, step numbers, quote marks, logo tile, starting dots on worksheets

handwritten.use: photo captions, testimonial quotes, the About sign-off line and worksheet lettering

logo.mark: A rounded orange (#C2410C) tile, tilted -6°, with a white handwritten lowercase "t" (2.6px round stroke on a 24px grid)
logo.wordmark: "Learning" / "with Toma" on two lines in Bricolage Grotesque, 800 and 500 weight
logo.favicon: The same tile upright, so it stays crisp at 16px (src/favicon.svg, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png)

illustration.style: Flat, friendly shapes with 2px ink outlines on a 64×64 grid, filled with the category colours

layout.paperGrid: 28px grid of 1px #EDF2FA lines on white (hero and About)

worksheets.paper: A4 sheets, the same on screen and in print
worksheets.instruction: Uppercase, 15px bold, #3D5A99, repeated at the top of every page
worksheets.footer: Learning with Toma · activity name, and learningwithtoma.com with the page number

rules: No child can be recognised: faces blurred, backs of heads, just the hands, finished worksheets
Photos are shown like prints: a white border, a slight tilt and a handwritten caption

ui.animations: subtle, and none when the user prefers reduced motion

mascot.name: Toma
mascot.description: A curious child who loves discovering new things.

messaging.homepageHeadline: Printable worksheets for little learners, ready in seconds.
messaging.homepageSubheadline: Pick one of 12 activities, choose your language, adjust a few settings and print. A fresh worksheet every time — no cost, no fuss.
messaging.support: If these little worksheets have brought a smile to your table, you can help keep them coming.
